title: Twelfth Station: Jesus Dies on the Cross
text:
Consider how Jesus, after three hours' agony on the Cross, consumed at length with anguish, abandons Himself into His Father's hands, bows His head, and dies.

My dying Jesus, I kiss devoutly the Cross on which Thou didst
die for love of me. I have merited by my sins to die a miserable
death, but Thy death is my hope. Ah, by the merits of Thy death,
give me grace to die with burning love only for Thee, I commit my
soul into Thy hands.
I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry
for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again.
Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
